brief:
Germany entered into legal proceedings Monday before the International Court of Justice in The Hague, mounting a defense against a lawsuit filed by Nicaragua, Shehab Wire reported. Nicaragua has accused Berlin of violating international obligations toward Palestinians by continuing to supply Israel with weapons and military equipment.

The case hinges on Nicaragua's allegations that Germany breaches its duties under international law in regard to Palestinian rights and protections. Germany moved to dismiss the charges during Monday's court session. The dispute reflects broader tensions over arms transfers to Israel and their relationship to international humanitarian obligations.
